actualSubject: Two vertically stacked hysteresis graph panels, not a portrait or apparatus.

panels.panelLabel: Cyrillic a-shaped subfigure mark below/right of the vertical axis
panels.axes: One horizontal axis through zero, extending left and right, rightward arrow; one vertical axis extending below and above zero, upward arrow. A dark downward wedge is visible at its bottom end and will be checked against candidate axis treatment.
labels: I at the positive vertical end
B with subscript 0 at the positive horizontal end
0 immediately below/left of the axes intersection
panels.curves: Two solid increasing S-shaped branches with common-looking negative lower-left and positive upper-right saturation ends; they enclose a very narrow nonzero-width hysteresis loop near the vertical axis.
panels.relationships: Left branch crosses the vertical axis above zero and the horizontal axis slightly left of zero. Right branch crosses the vertical axis below zero and the horizontal axis slightly right of zero. Both branches have the same sign of extreme I and extreme B0. Positive and negative endpoints are approximately opposite, but no exact coordinates, symmetry claim or numerical equality is printed.

Right branch crosses the vertical axis substantially below zero and the horizontal axis far right of zero.
